en.title: Bare Sudoku: Free Sudoku Online, No Ads, No Sign-Up
en.description: Free Sudoku in your browser: no ads, no account, no tracking. Four levels, notes, undo and hints that explain the logic. Works offline. Also a {size} KB Android app.
en.h1: Bare Sudoku: free Sudoku online, no ads, no sign-up
en.intro: Bare Sudoku is a free Sudoku game that runs in your browser. There are no ads, no account, no tracking and nothing to install: open the page, pick a level and play. Every puzzle has exactly one solution and can be solved by logic alone, and every hint explains the reasoning. The game works offline and is open source under the MIT license.
features: Four levels: Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert
Every puzzle has one solution and never needs guessing
Notes, undo, erase and fill all notes with one tap
Hints that explain the technique: singles, locked candidates, pairs and triples, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish and XYZ-Wing
Row, column, box and same-digit highlights, mistake marking you can turn off
Automatic save, dark mode, keyboard support and landscape layout
Works offline after the first visit, no app store needed
37 languages, each on its own page
en.android: Bare Sudoku is also a native Android app: version {version}, about {size} KB, no permissions, no internet access, plain Java with zero libraries. It is not on Google Play; download the signed APK from GitHub Releases and install it on Android 8 or newer.
en.privacy: Bare Sudoku collects no data. There is no account, no analytics and no cookies; your current game is saved only in your browser. The Android app has no internet permission at all.
faq: Is Bare Sudoku free?
Yes. Bare Sudoku is completely free in the browser and on Android. There are no ads, no in-app purchases and no premium version.
Does Bare Sudoku have ads?
No. Neither the web game nor the Android app shows ads, and there are no trackers or third-party scripts.
Do I need an account to play?
No. Open baresudoku.com and play. Your game is saved in the browser automatically, so you can close the tab and continue later.
Does Bare Sudoku work offline?
Yes. After the first visit the page is stored by the browser and opens without a connection. The Android app never uses the internet.
Are the puzzles always solvable without guessing?
Yes. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, and the generator checks that it can be solved with logical techniques only, up to the difficulty of the chosen level.
What do the hints explain?

A hint points to the next cell you can fill and names the technique: a single candidate, the only place for a digit in a row, column or box, locked candidates, pairs and triples, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish or XYZ-Wing. Tap the hint again to place the digit.
Does Bare Sudoku collect any data?
No. There is no analytics, no account and no cookies. The saved game lives only in your browser's local storage.
Is there an Android app?
Yes. Bare Sudoku for Android is a {size} KB APK for Android 8 and newer, with no permissions and no internet access. Download it from GitHub Releases.
Why is the Android app not on Google Play?
The app is distributed as a signed APK from GitHub to stay tiny and free of store requirements. Updates are signed with the same key, so a new version installs over the old one.
Which languages does Bare Sudoku support?
37 languages, each on its own page: English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Français, Español, 日本語, 한국어, 中文 and more. The game follows the page language and remembers your choice.
Can I play with the keyboard?
Yes. Use the arrow keys to move, 1 to 9 to enter a digit, Backspace to erase, N for notes, U for undo, H for a hint, F to fill notes and Escape for the menu.
Where is the source code?
The web game and the Android app are open source under the MIT license on GitHub: alparslandev/baresudoku-web and alparslandev/baresudoku.
en.ogAlt: Bare Sudoku logo with the words Free Sudoku online, no ads
en.privacyExtra: This policy covers the web game at baresudoku.com, the Android app and the iOS app. None of them connects to the internet for the game, shows ads, uses analytics or asks for personal data. Questions: open an issue on GitHub.

കളിക്കാൻ അക്കൗണ്ട് വേണോ?

Bare Sudoku ഓഫ്‌ലൈനിൽ പ്രവർത്തിക്കുമോ?

Bare Sudoku ഡാറ്റ ശേഖരിക്കുന്നുണ്ടോ?

tl.title: Bare Sudoku: Libreng Sudoku online, walang ads, walang sign-up
tl.description: Libreng Sudoku sa browser: walang ads, walang account, walang tracking. Apat na antas, mga tala, ibalik, at mga pahiwatig na nagpapaliwanag ng lohika. Gumagana offline. May {size} KB Android app din.
tl.h1: Bare Sudoku: libreng Sudoku online, walang ads, walang sign-up
tl.intro: Ang Bare Sudoku ay isang libreng larong Sudoku na tumatakbo sa iyong browser. Walang ads, walang account, walang tracking, at walang kailangang i-install: buksan ang pahina, pumili ng antas, at maglaro. Bawat puzzle ay may eksaktong isang solusyon at nalulutas sa lohika lamang, at bawat pahiwatig ay nagpapaliwanag ng dahilan nito. Gumagana ang laro offline at open source ito sa ilalim ng MIT license.
features: Apat na antas: Madali, Katamtaman, Mahirap, at Eksperto
Bawat puzzle ay may isang solusyon at hindi kailanman nangangailangan ng hula
Mga tala, ibalik, burahin, at punan ang lahat ng tala sa isang tap
Mga pahiwatig na nagpapaliwanag ng teknik: singles, naka-lock na kandidato, pares at tatlo, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish, at XYZ-Wing
Awtomatikong save, dark mode, keyboard, at landscape layout
Gumagana offline pagkatapos ng unang pagbisita, walang app store na kailangan
tl.android: Ang Bare Sudoku ay isa ring native na Android app: bersyon {version}, humigit-kumulang {size} KB, walang permiso, walang internet, purong Java na walang library. Wala ito sa Google Play; i-download ang signed APK mula sa GitHub Releases at i-install sa Android 8 o mas bago.
tl.privacy: Walang kinokolektang data ang Bare Sudoku. Walang account, walang analytics, walang cookies; ang kasalukuyang laro mo ay naka-save lamang sa iyong browser. Wala man lang permiso sa internet ang Android app.
faq: Libre ba ang Bare Sudoku?
Oo. Ganap na libre ang Bare Sudoku sa browser at sa Android. Walang ads, walang in-app purchase, at walang premium na bersyon.
May ads ba ang Bare Sudoku?
Wala. Hindi nagpapakita ng ads ang web game o ang Android app, at walang tracker o third-party script.
Kailangan ko ba ng account para maglaro?
Hindi. Buksan ang baresudoku.com at maglaro. Awtomatikong naka-save ang laro sa browser; isara ang tab at ituloy mamaya.
Gumagana ba offline ang Bare Sudoku?
Oo. Pagkatapos ng unang pagbisita, itinatago ng browser ang pahina at binubuksan nang walang koneksyon. Hindi kailanman gumagamit ng internet ang Android app.
Nangongolekta ba ng data ang Bare Sudoku?
Hindi. Walang analytics, walang account, walang cookies. Ang naka-save na laro ay nasa local storage lamang ng iyong browser.
May Android app ba?
Oo. Ang Bare Sudoku para sa Android ay isang {size} KB na APK para sa Android 8 pataas, walang permiso at walang internet. I-download mula sa GitHub Releases.

Iya. Bare Sudoku gratis kabeh ing browser lan ing Android. Ora ana iklan, ora ana tuku ing aplikasi, ora ana versi premium.
Apa Bare Sudoku ana iklane?

Bisa. Sawise dibukak sepisan, browser nyimpen kaca lan bisa dibukak tanpa sambungan. Aplikasi Android ora tau nganggo internet.

faq: Je, Bare Sudoku ni bure?
Ndiyo. Bare Sudoku ni bure kabisa kwenye kivinjari na kwenye Android. Hakuna matangazo, hakuna ununuzi ndani ya programu na hakuna toleo la malipo.
Je, Bare Sudoku ina matangazo?

Hapana. Fungua baresudoku.com na ucheze. Mchezo unahifadhiwa kiotomatiki kwenye kivinjari; funga kichupo na uendelee baadaye.
Je, Bare Sudoku inafanya kazi nje ya mtandao?

Je, Bare Sudoku inakusanya data?

Sí. Després de la primera visita el navegador desa la pàgina i l'obre sense connexió. L'app per a Android mai no fa servir Internet.
Bare Sudoku recull dades?

ທຸກປິດສະໜາມີຄຳຕອບດຽວ ແລະ ບໍ່ຕ້ອງເດົາ
ບັນທຶກ, ຍົກເລີກ, ລຶບ ແລະ ຕື່ມບັນທຶກທັງໝົດດ້ວຍການແຕະຄັ້ງດຽວ
ຄຳໃບ້ທີ່ອະທິບາຍເຕັກນິກ: ດ່ຽວ, ຜູ້ສະໝັກທີ່ຖືກລັອກ, ຄູ່ ແລະ ສາມ, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish ແລະ XYZ-Wing
ບັນທຶກອັດຕະໂນມັດ, ໂໝດມືດ, ແປ້ນພິມ ແລະ ຮູບແບບແນວນອນ
ໃຊ້ໄດ້ອອບລາຍຫຼັງຈາກເປີດຄັ້ງທຳອິດ, ບໍ່ຕ້ອງໃຊ້ຮ້ານແອັບ
lo.android: Bare Sudoku ຍັງມີເປັນແອັບ Android ນຳ: ເວີຊັນ {version}, ປະມານ {size} KB, ບໍ່ມີການອະນຸຍາດ, ບໍ່ໃຊ້ອິນເຕີເນັດ, Java ບໍລິສຸດບໍ່ມີໄລບຣາຣີ. ມັນບໍ່ມີໃນ Google Play; ດາວໂຫຼດ APK ທີ່ເຊັນແລ້ວຈາກ GitHub Releases ແລະ ຕິດຕັ້ງໃນ Android 8 ຫຼື ໃໝ່ກວ່າ.
lo.privacyHeading: ຄວາມເປັນສ່ວນຕົວ
lo.privacy: Bare Sudoku ບໍ່ເກັບຂໍ້ມູນໃດໆ. ບໍ່ມີບັນຊີ, ບໍ່ມີການວິເຄາະ, ບໍ່ມີຄຸກກີ້; ເກມປັດຈຸບັນຂອງທ່ານຖືກບັນທຶກໄວ້ໃນບຣາວເຊີຂອງທ່ານເທົ່ານັ້ນ. ແອັບ Android ບໍ່ມີແມ້ແຕ່ການອະນຸຍາດອິນເຕີເນັດ.
lo.faqHeading: ຄຳຖາມທີ່ພົບເລື້ອຍ
faq: Bare Sudoku ຟຣີບໍ?
ຟຣີ. Bare Sudoku ຟຣີທັງໝົດໃນບຣາວເຊີ ແລະ ໃນ Android. ບໍ່ມີໂຄສະນາ, ບໍ່ມີການຊື້ໃນແອັບ ແລະ ບໍ່ມີເວີຊັນພຣີມຽມ.
Bare Sudoku ມີໂຄສະນາບໍ?
ບໍ່ມີ. ທັງເກມເວັບ ແລະ ແອັບ Android ບໍ່ສະແດງໂຄສະນາ ແລະ ບໍ່ມີຕົວຕິດຕາມ ຫຼື ສະຄຣິບພາກສ່ວນທີສາມ.
ຕ້ອງມີບັນຊີເພື່ອຫຼິ້ນບໍ?
ບໍ່ຕ້ອງ. ເປີດ baresudoku.com ແລະ ຫຼິ້ນ. ເກມຖືກບັນທຶກໃນບຣາວເຊີໂດຍອັດຕະໂນມັດ; ປິດແທັບ ແລະ ຫຼິ້ນຕໍ່ພາຍຫຼັງ.
Bare Sudoku ໃຊ້ໄດ້ອອບລາຍບໍ?
ໄດ້. ຫຼັງຈາກເປີດຄັ້ງທຳອິດ ບຣາວເຊີເກັບໜ້າໄວ້ ແລະ ເປີດໄດ້ໂດຍບໍ່ມີການເຊື່ອມຕໍ່. ແອັບ Android ບໍ່ເຄີຍໃຊ້ອິນເຕີເນັດ.
Bare Sudoku ເກັບຂໍ້ມູນບໍ?
ບໍ່. ບໍ່ມີການວິເຄາະ, ບໍ່ມີບັນຊີ, ບໍ່ມີຄຸກກີ້. ເກມທີ່ບັນທຶກໄວ້ຢູ່ໃນບ່ອນເກັບຂໍ້ມູນທ້ອງຖິ່ນຂອງບຣາວເຊີເທົ່ານັ້ນ.
ມີແອັບ Android ບໍ?
ມີ. Bare Sudoku ສຳລັບ Android ແມ່ນ APK {size} KB ສຳລັບ Android 8 ຂຶ້ນໄປ, ບໍ່ມີການອະນຸຍາດ ແລະ ບໍ່ໃຊ້ອິນເຕີເນັດ. ດາວໂຫຼດຈາກ GitHub Releases.
